notes: 'a small heap of threads' follows the flock-of-birds shape (collective noun by Member + GroupOf on the member kind), and 'small' is a property of the collection itself, which is the one licensed use of a bare Member on a group symbol; 'each night' takes the named-slot Time term plus its implied (Every e 1 day) cycle, and 'in moth-season' a second composing Time atom. The (Every e 1 day) is the instruction set's mechanical named-slot output and so slightly outruns the moth-season restriction, which is nonetheless carried by its own Time atom.
